items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And this is Johnny Barsdorf's band at the Tokyo Gardens, 1922.

ctx.x: Yeah, I'll, it's the one with the, uh, this must be the third edition, huh?

Monk, this is Monk Smith, Benji White, Earl Crum, Lois Farrell, Grené Jalpe, and now the violin players, Eblen Ra, I never did know him. Yeah. I didn't know him. Yeah, he'd be wrong. And then Dick Mackey. And this is Johnny Barsdorf's band at the Tokyo Gardens, 1922. Morton Abraham was Chick Morton. Mm-hmm. Tom Brown, trombone. Johnny Barsdorf, trumpet. Leo Addy, pothead. I used to call him pothead. Oh, yeah. But it had nothing to do with, with pot. Johnny Miller, he was, I could break a piano for you. Yeah.…
